import MilneLib.Quotient.InvariantQuotientFree

/-!
# Freeness of semilinear Galois actions on schemes

A scheme action compatible with the natural Galois action on `Spec L` is
free on field-valued points. Consequently its canonical finite-group quotient
is etale whenever the affine-orbit construction applies. This is a geometric
input to finite Galois descent in Milne III.1.13.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u

open CategoryTheory AlgebraicGeometry

namespace MilneLib.StableGroupAction

variable {K L : Type u} [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L]
  {X : Scheme.{u}} (act : (L ≃ₐ[K] L) →* Aut X)
  (p : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of L))
  (hact : ∀ g : L ≃ₐ[K] L,
    (act g).hom ≫ p = p ≫ (specAction (L ≃ₐ[K] L) L g).hom)

/-- A semilinear Galois action fixes the structure map to the smaller field. -/
theorem galois_action_comp_base
    (p : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of L))
    (hact : ∀ g : L ≃ₐ[K] L,
      (act g).hom ≫ p = p ≫ (specAction (L ≃ₐ[K] L) L g).hom)
    (g : L ≃ₐ[K] L) :
    (act g).hom ≫ (p ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L))) =
      p ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L)) := by
  rw [← Category.assoc, hact g, Category.assoc, specAction_hom,
    ← Spec.map_comp, ← CommRingCat.ofHom_comp]
  congr 2
  ext a
  exact g⁻¹.commutes a

/-- A field-valued fixed point of a semilinear scheme action forces the
acting Galois automorphism to be the identity. -/
theorem galois_action_free_field_points
    (p : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of L))
    (hact : ∀ g : L ≃ₐ[K] L,
      (act g).hom ≫ p = p ≫ (specAction (L ≃ₐ[K] L) L g).hom)
    (F : Type u) [Field F] (x : Spec (CommRingCat.of F) ⟶ X)
    (g : L ≃ₐ[K] L) (hx : x ≫ (act g).hom = x) : g = 1 := by
  have h : (x ≫ p) ≫ (specAction (L ≃ₐ[K] L) L g).hom = x ≫ p := by
    rw [Category.assoc, ← hact g, ← Category.assoc, hx]
  rw [specAction_hom] at h
  have hmap :
      CommRingCat.ofHom (MulSemiringAction.toRingHom (L ≃ₐ[K] L) L g⁻¹) ≫
        Spec.preimage (x ≫ p) = Spec.preimage (x ≫ p) := by
    apply Spec.map_injective
    simpa only [Spec.map_comp, Spec.map_preimage] using h
  have hr : (MulSemiringAction.toRingHom (L ≃ₐ[K] L) L g⁻¹) = RingHom.id L := by
    apply RingHom.ext
    intro a
    apply (Spec.preimage (x ≫ p)).hom.injective
    exact congrArg (fun f : CommRingCat.of L ⟶ CommRingCat.of F => f.hom a) hmap
  have hgi : g⁻¹ = (1 : L ≃ₐ[K] L) := by
    ext a
    simpa using DFunLike.congr_fun hr a
  exact inv_eq_one.mp hgi

open StableAffineOpen

variable [FiniteDimensional K L] [X.IsSeparated] [CompactSpace X]

/-- The canonical quotient of a semilinear Galois scheme action is etale.
Freeness is derived from the action on the field, without a separate
fixed-point hypothesis. -/
theorem finiteStableCanonicalQuotientProjection_etale_of_galois
    (h : OrbitsInAffineOpen act) :
    Etale (finiteStableCanonicalQuotientProjection act
      (p ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L)))
      (galois_action_comp_base act p hact) h) :=
  finiteStableCanonicalQuotientProjection_etale_of_field_points act _ _ h
    (galois_action_free_field_points act p hact)

end MilneLib.StableGroupAction
